outputs.explanation: Panel A shows flow cytometry pseudocolor/scatter plots (gating for singlets, live cells, lymphocytes, B cells, B-cell subsets). Each dot represents an individual cell event, so this is scatter-plot data, not an averaged summary statistic requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel B shows flow cytometry scatter plots for identifying plasma cells (CD98/CD19 and FSC-A/IgD). These display individual cell events directly rather than an averaged summary statistic.

Panel C shows flow cytometry gating plots for NP-specific GC and MBC (IgM/IgD, Fas/NP, CD38/CD138). These are scatter/dot plots of raw cell events, not averaged data requiring individual point overlay.

Panel D is a color-coded overlay scatter plot (CD62L/CD44 and CD80/PD-L2) showing individual cell events from MBC, GC, and naive populations. It is inherently a scatter plot of raw data points, not an averaged summary chart.
Panel E shows flow cytometry gating scatter plots (CD62L/CD44 and CD80/PD-L2) for MBC subset identification, displaying individual cell events rather than aggregated/averaged data.
